quote_token_keyed_default_exists.meaning: a default noCapLimit override keyed by the market's quoteToken was set via setDefaultNoCapLimit

market_params_have_tokens.meaning: initMarket is invoked with marketParams containing a baseToken and a quoteToken

lookup_keyed_by_quote_token.meaning: initMarket looks up the default noCapLimit using marketParams.quoteToken as the mapping key, so quote-token-specific overrides apply

init_market_completed.meaning: initMarket completes market initialization without reverting (no DoS on initialization)

assumptions: initMarket is the operation whose completion is at stake; the report does not state caller or authorization conditions.
The quote-token-keyed default override is assumed to be the intended lookup key per i_quote_token_keyed_lookup.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the concrete mechanism by which the wrong-key lookup causes a revert/DoS on initialization; only the potential DoS outcome is asserted.
Fallback noCapLimit value is described inconsistently (fallback to 1 vs defaulting to 0 meaning 1 baseToken cap).

limitations: DoS on initialization is formalized only as absence of successful initMarket completion; the report does not give the revert condition or numeric cap values.
Other impacts (incorrect cap limits, unexpected mint/redeem behavior) are not covered by this plan.
